card.name: Word just before formed, made, or developed
card.fires_on: Adverbs, auxiliaries, or nouns that sit between a subject and a past-participle verb like formed, produced, made, generated or developed. The next word is expected to be a verb of creation.

modes.label: Negation before formed
modes.description: The word "not" after "precipitates have" in mixing instructions, right before "formed".
modes.example: Inspect the container to ensure precipitates have<< not>> formed during the mixing or addition of additives

modes.label: Adverb before developed or produced
modes.description: An adverb or prefix that comes right before a creation verb such as developed or produced.
modes.example: as the insects have<< gradually>> developed resistance to the chemical.

modes.label: Passive with made or generated
modes.description: A noun or auxiliary in a passive phrase that leads into made or generated.
modes.example: a list<< is>> made by the worm.

card.writes: It promotes built, developed and created, and suppresses noun forms like formation and creation, so it pushes toward a past-participle verb of making.
card.plain: It fires on the small word just before a verb like formed, made or developed, when the model expects that verb next.
